title: Sr. Technical Product Manager
jd_text: Job Description Position Summary: We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who owns the technical strategy and platform evolution behind a key product line — someone who thinks in platforms rather than features, operates with AI tools as core infrastructure, and translates deep technical work into clear business impact. This role sits at the interface of Product and Engineering. You will own the technical roadmap for your area — new capabilities, platform infrastructure, technical debt, security, and scaling — and keep Architecture and Engineering aligned with the business-facing teams that depend on them. You should already be using AI to accelerate your own work, be comfortable reading architecture diagrams and reviewing API designs, and bring strong opinions about how SaaS platforms should be designed, measured, and scaled. Your work will help our customers reach their goals and drive Momentive’s growth forward. This position reports to the Director of Product Management. This is a remote, US-based position. Key Responsibilities: Create, own, and maintain the technical product roadmap for your area — spanning new features and capabilities, platform infrastructure, technical debt remediation, security fixes, and scaling mechanisms. Develop an in-depth understanding of the platform architecture and how it interacts with product use cases, the broader Momentive portfolio, and third-party integrations. Translate product-line needs and stakeholder input into clear technical requirements, initiatives, and epics for Engineering — identifying shared patterns and consolidating duplicated efforts into scalable, reusable capabilities. Maintain alignment between Architecture/Engineering teams and Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and other non-R&D functions — translating complex platform decisions into clear business-impact narratives. Work with Support to triage and prioritize operational issues impacting customers and the broader platform. Drive Product/Architecture interface process improvement, ensuring clean handoffs and shared accountability across teams. Monitor platform adoption, usage, performance, and reliability metrics, and use data to drive technical investment decisions. Act as Product Owner when needed, operating with high autonomy in a role where success depends on influence across teams you do not directly control. Use AI tools as core tools in your daily work — not as novelties, but as force multipliers for research, analysis, communication, and decision-making: Use AI to prototype technical approaches, analyze cross-product usage data, and generate first-draft technical specifications and requirements that you then refine with engineering judgment. Compress discovery and analysis cycles by using AI to synthesize stakeholder input, assess existing systems and data flows, and surface insights that would otherwise take weeks. Stay current on AI tooling and platform patterns, and share effective approaches with the broader product and engineering organization. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent work experience; 5+ years in a software/SaaS environment, including 4+ years in a product management role. Advanced technical understanding of networking, databases, operating systems, APIs, microservices, and cloud infrastructure — with the depth to read architecture diagrams, review API designs, and engage in detailed technical discussions with engineers. Experience defining APIs, data contracts, and integration approaches, and managing platform or system migrations while maintaining continuity for dependent teams and customers. Advanced understanding of Agile processes and deployment methodologies, including CI/CD; strong grasp of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Demonstrated, meaningful use of AI tools in your own workflow. You should be able to speak concretely to how AI has changed the way you work, what it’s replaced, and where you’ve found its limits. Ability to derive and apply technical product strategy across one or more products on a 6–12 month time horizon, grounded in strong market and portfolio analysis. Experience with secure coding, compliance, and security practices. Strong experience with Jira and metrics tracking for optimal team output. Experience working with Associations and/or Nonprofits is a plus. Ideal Candidate Attributes: Platform Thinker: Thinks in systems rather than features — building capabilities that scale across products and serve multiple teams through a shared core. Technically Fluent: Comfortable in deep technical discussions with engineers, and able to translate complex architecture into clear narratives for leadership, product peers, and GTM teams. Outcome-Focused: Draws a clear line from technical decisions to customer success and business results, and uses data to drive investment and prioritization. Influential Leader: Drives outcomes across teams they do not directly control, building alignment and shared accountability through influence. AI-Native: Treats AI as a core part of the job, not a novelty. Uses it daily to prototype, analyze, and communicate, and shares what works with the team. Owner: Demonstrates significant initiative and end-to-end ownership, with an uncompromising commitment to product quality, reliability, performance, and scalability. About Us Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com . Why Work Here? At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here. Medical, Dental & Vision Benefits 401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match Flexible Planned Paid Time Off Generous Sick Leave Inclusive & Welcoming Environment Purpose-Driven Culture Work-Life Balance Commitment to Community Involvement Employer-Paid Parental Leave Employer-Paid Short-Term Disability Remote Work Flexibility Momentive Software actively embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a meaningful way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, which is why we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. All persons hired will be required to verify identity, minimum age of 18, eligibility to work in the United States (without sponsorship), and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

title: Sr. Product Systems Analyst, (FT/REMOTE) (USC or GC req'd)
jd_text: About Us: Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Virtix Health offers virtual wellness visits, in-home health risk assessments, retrospective chart review, workflow technology and member/patient engagement service offerings for health plans of all sizes. The company supports health plans by creating elevated experiences for their members with the latest technology on an open, connected ecosystem, yielding insights that make a difference for customers and their members. This is a remote position. Employees must reside and perform all work within the continental United States for the duration of employment. This is a remote position. This person is responsible for planning, managing and executing business analysis activities throughout a project lifecycle. Virtix Health uses various applications to manage all enhancement requests or defect fixes that will be assigned to the Technology team; and must be familiar with the Agile development process with rapid development Sprints. The SR Business Systems reports to the VP Product Management. The SR BSA must abide with HIPAA regulations pertaining to safeguarding and protecting patient’s right to privacy in handling all medical chart records. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and translating business needs into technology solutions. Proven experience f acilitating stakeholder discovery sessions and eliciting both stated and underlying business requirements. Demonstrated ability to create and maintain business requirements documentation, including BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, workflow diagrams, and functional requirements . Experience serving as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure successful solution design and delivery. Strong documentation skills with experience maintaining requirements and project artifacts in Jira , Confluence, or similar platforms. Ability to create wireframes, mockups, or process designs using tools such as Figma, Visio, PowerPoint, or similar applications to support requirements definition and solution development. Experience documenting data integrations, system interfaces, data flows, and field-level mapping between applications. Working knowledge of flat-file data formats, including CSV, TXT, and Excel, with the ability to define layouts, validation rules, and reporting requirements. Experience developing test cases, executing testing activities, analyzing results, and documenting defects or issues . Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills with the ability to interpret findings and provide clear, actionable recommendations. Demonstrated c onsultative and relationship-building skills, including questioning, negotiation, facilitation, and active listening. Effective communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization without direct authority. Experience validating data, identifying data quality or integrity issues, and supporting reporting and analytics initiatives. Good understanding of business processes, technology solutions, and performance metrics. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with API-based integrations and data exchange concepts. Experience using SQL for data validation, analysis, and troubleshooting. Product Owner or Product Management experience supporting proprietary software applications and managing enhancement backlogs . Nice to have: Experience within healthcare technology, healthcare operations, revenue cycle management, or healthcare interoperability environments. Nice to have: Exposure to FHIR APIs, healthcare data standards, and interoperability frameworks. Technical Skills & Tools Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Intermediate-level Microsoft SQL skills for data validation, analysis, and troubleshooting. Experience using Smartsheet for project planning, tracking, and collaboration. Experience with Figma or similar wireframing/prototyping tools. Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for requirements management, documentation, and Agile delivery. Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools such as Claude or similar generative AI platforms. The Technical Product Manager (TPM) brings technical expertise, focusing on developing and delivering actionable, scalable, and reliable technology solutions that are in line with current industry standards. They will work closely with all areas of the company to ensure the Data Solution’s roadmap is supporting business goals and plugging the team into the work at the right time. title: Implementation Specialist (Banking Technology & Core Conversions)
jd_text: Job Description: The Implementation Specialist is responsible for supporting the successful planning, installation, configuration, testing, conversion, and implementation of CSI's NuPoint core banking solutions and related technologies. This role serves as a key liaison between customers, core providers, vendors, and internal CSI teams to ensure implementations are completed accurately, on schedule, and with a high level of customer satisfaction. The position combines customer-facing project coordination responsibilities with hands-on technical implementation work. The Implementation Specialist assists with software deployments, data conversions, user setup, troubleshooting, testing, training, and go-live activities while helping customers successfully transition to CSI solutions. What You'll Do Customer Communication & Project Coordination Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned implementation projects. Communicate effectively with bank leadership, end users, vendors, core providers, and internal CSI teams. Coordinate implementation activities, project milestones, and customer expectations throughout the conversion process. Gather and document customer requirements and project information. Communicate project risks, status updates, and implementation recommendations to appropriate stakeholders. Build strong working relationships with customers and internal business partners. Coordinate resources and escalate issues when additional expertise is required. Data Conversion & Implementation Support Coordinate with financial institutions and their existing core providers to obtain customer data files required for conversion and testing. Download, transfer, and distribute customer files using FTP and other secure file-transfer methods. Track conversion deliverables and ensure required files are received on schedule. Support customer conversion planning, preparation, execution, and validation activities. Configure test-bank environments to support customer testing and validation. Set up users, permissions, and system access in both testing and production environments. Identify, document, and escalate conversion issues requiring additional review. Software Installation & Configuration Install, configure, and support NuPoint software and related ancillary applications. Assist with hardware, workstation, and peripheral installations at customer locations. Configure software, system settings, and application environments according to project requirements. Validate hardware and software functionality prior to customer testing and production conversion. Coordinate implementation activities with engineering, support, and infrastructure teams. Maintain knowledge of CSI products, implementation processes, and technology solutions. Troubleshooting & Technical Support Troubleshoot workstation, application, connectivity, hardware, and software issues during implementations and conversions. Perform first-level issue triage and determine appropriate resolution paths. Work with NetOps, SecOps, Managed Services, customer IT teams, and third-party vendors to resolve technical issues. Support customers during testing, conversion weekends, and go-live activities. Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate technical teams while maintaining customer communication. Assist in maintaining stable customer environments throughout implementation activities. Training & Go-Live Support Guide customers through testing and validation activities. Deliver training and knowledge-transfer sessions to end users and customer stakeholders. Support implementation, go-live, hyper-care, and transition activities. Provide initial post-conversion support and assist with issue resolution. Coordinate successful transitions to CSI support teams following implementation completion. Help ensure customers are fully prepared to operate their new environment successfully. Documentation & Project Delivery Maintain implementation documentation, configuration records, testing results, and project notes. Document completed work, technical changes, issues, resolutions, and customer requirements. Support project schedules, milestones, and implementation deliverables. Assist in developing runbooks, knowledge-base materials, and implementation documentation. Complete assigned work according to customer, project, budget, and timeline expectations. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications Minimum of 1-2 years of relevant IT, technical support, implementation, help desk, desktop support, systems administration, or related experience. Associate degree, technical certification, trade-school education, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences. Customer-service mindset with strong relationship-building skills. Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. General knowledge of computer hardware, software, operating systems, and networking fundamentals. Experience installing, configuring, or supporting software applications and end-user systems. Familiarity with file transfers, FTP concepts, and basic technical file management. Strong organization, time-management, and project-coordination skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. Ability to learn new technologies, products, and implementation processes. Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40-50%. Preferred Qualifications Banking or financial institution experience. Core banking implementation or conversion experience. NuPoint experience. Experience supporting software implementations or technology deployments. Customer-facing implementation, training, or consulting experience. Familiarity with data conversion, testing, and go-live activities. Experience working with managed-service providers, infrastructure teams, or customer IT organizations. Travel Requirements Travel is expected to average approximately 40-50% depending on implementation schedules and customer needs. Travel generally consists of two-to-five-day customer visits occurring several times per month and may fluctuate based on conversion activity and project demand. What Success Looks Like Success in this role will be measured through: Successful implementation and conversion outcomes. Customer satisfaction throughout the implementation lifecycle. Accurate and timely completion of implementation deliverables. Effective troubleshooting and issue resolution. Strong communication with customers, vendors, and internal teams. Quality of implementation documentation and project records. Successful completion of testing and go-live activities. Effective coordination of CSI resources and customer stakeholders. Ability to learn and grow within CSI's evolving implementation organization. As a forward-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. Along with a competitive salary, this position includes eligibility for incentive awards based on both individual and business performance. We also offer a comprehensive range of benefits. title: Senior Product Manager (Platform)
jd_text: At Vio https://www.vio.com/, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world's fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. Who we're looking for We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own platform products at Vio. Our platform is where the economics of the marketplace get decided. Pricing, request optimization, price accuracy, supply integration, content, and the APIs we expose to partners. These systems determine which accommodations and deals a traveler sees, drive their decision-making, and shape what we earn on it. They have a direct impact on both our internal teams and end-user experience. You will join one of our platform domains and own several of its products end to end. Platform work at Vio shows up in margin, yield and conversion, and your decisions should land there. - Discover opportunities, scope them, and give your squad a clear what and a why they believe. - Translate complex, ambiguous challenges into clearly scoped initiatives that deliver concrete outcomes. - Collaborate closely with other PMs, analysts, engineers, data scientists and leadership to align priorities and ensure group-level strategy is translated into impactful work. - Be a hands-on PM: dive into data, read documentation, QA features, and debug with engineers when needed. - Raise the bar on how your team develops product, not only on what it ships. - Use AI as a tool in your own product work, and help the group get better at it. Who you are - You have 6+ years in product management, or fewer with a strong engineering or data background behind it. - You have owned platform or technical products where the output was a price, an offer, a ranking, a match or a data feed, rather than primarily a screen. You understand the system, not just the interface. - You have experience with data-driven product development and worked according to agile methodologies, with a passion for solving problems translating solutions into requirements that your team can execute. - You are comfortable with APIs, integrations, data models, algorithms and recommendation systems, and you hold your own with engineers on decisions that shape architecture. title: AI-Native Senior Product Manager
jd_text: Job Description Position Summary: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who leads with product instinct, operates with AI tools as core infrastructure, and ships products that help our customers and our business achieve their goals. This role is built for a product manager with genuine AI fluency who uses it to operate at a different level — compressing research cycles, accelerating decisions, and raising the quality of everything the team produces. You will own a product area end-to-end, from market and customer understanding through roadmap delivery and cross-functional alignment, working closely with engineering, design, customer success, and go-to-market teams to make sure what we build solves real problems and delivers measurable value. Your work will help our customers reach their goals and drive Momentive’s growth forward. This position reports to the Director of Product Management. This is a remote, US-based position. Key Responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of the market, competitive dynamics, and emerging trends — and engage directly with users and buyers through interviews, data analysis, and feedback loops to uncover pain points, use cases, and unmet needs. Own and evolve a 6–12 month roadmap for your product area — managing dependencies, tracking delivery, and adjusting as priorities shift — while keeping a clear line of sight to whether delivery translates into customer adoption, retention, and revenue. Translate stakeholder input and customer needs into structured initiatives and epics, ensuring clarity and alignment across teams. Define and own the KPIs that measure product health and validate whether released features actually deliver value — then use what you learn to drive the next cycle Use AI tools as core tools in your daily work — not as novelties, but as force multipliers for research, analysis, communication, and decision-making: Compress discovery and validation cycles by using AI to synthesize customer feedback, analyze competitive landscapes, dig through large datasets and interviews, and generate first-draft artifacts (PRDs, specs, user stories) that you then refine with product judgment. Use AI for rapid prototyping: build working prototypes to put in front of customers and validate direction early and often. Arrive at planning discussions with working analyses and a clear point of view — not just slide decks. Act as a central point of communication between Engineering and business-facing teams (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), and partner with senior leadership to define and communicate your product area’s vision and positioning. Champion innovation within your product area — identifying opportunities for differentiation and running experiments that test new ideas quickly. Manage Product Owners and mentor Product Managers: provide direction, coaching, and feedback to ensure effective backlog management, well-crafted user stories, and strong execution that reflects strategic intent and customer value. Step in to absorb Product Owner duties when needed. Contribute to the continuous improvement of product development practices, tools, and collaboration methods across the Product organization. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience; 5+ years in a software/SaaS environment, including 4+ years in a product management role with go-to-market experience. Demonstrated, meaningful use of AI tools in your own PM workflow. You should be able to speak concretely to how AI has changed the way you work, what it’s replaced, and where you’ve found its limits. Proven success driving product strategy on a 6–12 month horizon that delivers measurable customer and business outcomes — grounded in strong market analysis and an understanding of product packaging and pricing. Proven experience mentoring or guiding Product Owners, Business Analysts, or other product team members, and leading through influence to build strong cross-functional partnerships. Proven success working in Agile environments, including driving process improvement and tracking metrics for optimal team output. Revenue fluency and strong business acumen: able to read customer signals as product priorities with business outcomes attached — including churn risk, deal blockers, and expansion opportunities — and comfortable presenting to executives and external partners. Advanced understanding of networks, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and Agile practices — enough to reason about how technical choices affect product decisions. Strong experience with Jira; comfort with AI-assisted prototyping and development tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, or similar) to validate concepts and accelerate decision-making. Experience working with Associations and/or Nonprofits is a plus. Ideal Candidate Attributes: Customer-Obsessed: Prioritizes customer needs and continuously works to understand and solve real problems. Strategic Thinker: Zooms out to see the big-picture vision while managing the details that drive execution; uses data to guide decisions and trusts judgment when the data runs out. Influential Leader: Aligns and inspires cross-functional teams and stakeholders, building partnerships and driving momentum across teams and time zones. Outcome-Focused: Draws a clear line from product decisions to customer success and business results, and treats shipping as the start of accountability, not the end. AI-Native: Treats AI as a core part of the job, not a novelty. Uses it daily for research, synthesis, prototyping, and communication, and shares what works with the team. title: Implementation Consultant - Path
jd_text: Job Description WHO WE ARE Your members run lean. Your donors expect impact. Your staff is juggling a dozen systems to make it happen. At Momentive Software, we build the technology that makes that easier. We are the leading software platform for nonprofits and associations, serving more than 37,000 mission-driven organizations for over 40 years. Our portfolio covers every core need: association management (MC Trade, NimbleAMS, YourMembership, WildApricot, and more), event management (A2Z Events), learning management (Path LMS), fundraising (GiveSmart), accounting (MIP Accounting), certification management, career centers, volunteer management, and community tools — connected through one ecosystem. MomentiveIQ, our AI layer, automates workflows, personalizes engagement, and surfaces insights across every product. We're remote-first, inclusive by design, and serious about the work because our clients' missions are serious. WHO WE NEED We're looking for an Implementation Consultant to join our Client Services team. You'll lead onboarding projects for new clients and deliver professional services consulting for existing ones. You combine the consultative instincts to guide an executive through a discovery session with the technical depth to configure a platform and validate that it works the way the client needs it to. This role sits at the intersection of project management, technical configuration, and client relationship-building. You will work across our association management and learning management platforms, helping organizations go live, adopt best practices, and get full value from their investment. WHO YOU ARE You're an experienced implementation professional who learns new platforms quickly and explains them clearly — to a technical administrator and to an executive director in the same week. You manage competing priorities without dropping details, hold timelines without losing relationships, and push for quality without waiting to be asked. You treat every client engagement as a consulting project: listen first, configure second, train third. You document what you build, share what you learn, and look for ways to make the next implementation better than the last. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT Lead Client Implementations Own end-to-end onboarding projects from kickoff through go-live, managing scope, timelines, milestones, and risks throughout. Set and maintain client expectations — communicating changes proactively, surfacing issues early, and keeping projects moving through shifting priorities. Hold clients and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed timelines without damaging the relationship. Navigate changing requirements while maintaining project momentum and delivering successful outcomes. Configure and Deliver Solutions Conduct discovery to understand each client's business processes, then translate those requirements into platform configurations that fit how they actually work. Configure application settings, workflows, and platform options to meet each client's functional and reporting needs. Support data imports and validate data setup to ensure a clean, accurate go-live. Define, execute, and document testing to confirm client requirements are met before cutover. Troubleshoot and resolve configuration and system setup issues throughout the implementation lifecycle. Guide and Enable Client Teams Help clients understand how to get the most from the platform by sharing best practices, recommending workflow approaches, and connecting their business processes to platform capabilities. Act as the primary point of guidance throughout the implementation — answering questions, clarifying how features apply to their specific context, and helping teams feel ready at go-live. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at every level, from day-to-day administrators to executive leadership. Serve as a trusted advisor: surface risks before they become problems, help clients make informed configuration decisions, and set them up for long-term success. Strengthen the Team Collaborate across Client Success, Support, Sales, and Product to deliver clean handoffs and consistent client experiences. Document client configurations, customizations, and key decisions so post-implementation transitions are smooth. Help build and improve team assets — playbooks, templates, process guides — so our implementation practice gets more consistent and repeatable over time. Share what you know: contribute to documentation, provide product feedback, and support teammates on the platforms and processes you know well. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In Your First 90 Days Days 1–30: Get grounded. Complete onboarding on our platforms, internal systems, and implementation methodology. Shadow active client implementations to understand how we run projects end to end. Establish working relationships with cross-functional partners in Client Success, Support, and Product. Days 31–60: Start executing. Take ownership of straightforward implementation projects with support from the team. Begin managing client communications, configuration tasks, and project milestones independently on simpler engagements. Demonstrate proficiency in core platform configuration workflows and data setup processes. Days 61–90: Build momentum. Carry a small active portfolio with increasing independence across project types. Identify at least one area where you can contribute to improving how the team works. At 6–12 Months Independently manage a full client portfolio from kickoff through go-live. Consistently meet or exceed client satisfaction (CSAT) targets at implementation close. Deliver implementations on or ahead of contracted timelines. Identify and resolve implementation risks before they escalate to client-impacting issues. Contribute at least one improvement to an existing team asset — a playbook, template, or process guide — that makes future implementations smoother. WHAT YOU BRING Experience 2–4 years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical consulting, or software delivery. Proven track record managing multiple concurrent implementation projects. Experience with Association Management Software (AMS), Learning Management Software (LMS), or similar nonprofit or membership platforms preferred. Bachelor's degree in Business, a technical field, or equivalent practical experience preferred. Technical Skills Comfort configuring SaaS platforms — navigating admin settings, workflow tools, and configuration options to match client requirements. Experience supporting data imports and validating data accuracy prior to go-live. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and validation. Experience with project or development management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Trello. Comfort using AI tools to improve day-to-day work — whether for drafting communications, researching solutions, or finding faster ways to get things done. Professional Skills Clear, direct written and verbal communication — including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Strong project management instincts: you prioritize well, track details, and keep work moving. Client-first mindset with genuine investment in client outcomes, not just on-time delivery. Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely across cross-functional teams. Proactive approach to process improvement: you look for patterns, document what works, and share it. Project management certification (PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent) is a plus. jd_text: Place of work: Remote, Slovakia Base salary: minimum 2000€ / monthly (depending on experiences and quality of the candidate) Contract type: full-time Start date: by agreement Key responsibilities: Collaborate with stakeholders to identify process inefficiencies and recommend opportunities for optimization through process redesign, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Conduct interviews, workshops, and analysis sessions to elicit and document user stories, use cases, and functional/non-functional requirements. Identify opportunities to streamline processes using low‑code automation and AI‑assisted solutions, initially with generative AI. Build and test AI‑enabled workflows under supervision, with humans kept firmly in the loop. Help refine prompts, workflows, and automation logic based on feedback and performance data. Track metrics such as cost avoidance, time saved, error reduction, and adoption. Use evidence and feedback to recommend improvements and next steps. Learn and apply responsible AI, data privacy, and governance standards in everything you do. Drive awareness of requirements across business units and identify standard systems processes through evaluation of real-time data. Determine and develop user requirements for systems in production, to ensure maximum usability Maintain relationships with partners for optimized systems integration, and respond to questions and concerns from managers and executives with supporting research and recommendations. Create comprehensive and clear documentation such as business requirements documents (BRD), functional requirements documents (FRD), and use case specifications. Develop process models, workflow diagrams, and prototypes to depict proposed solutions. Work closely with IT Architects, technical teams (in particular AI Delivery), vendors to design feasible solutions fullfill business needs. Evaluate existing Convatec systems and propose improvements or new solutions to optimize processes. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring effective communication and understanding of requirements. Collaborate with project managers, developers, and testers to ensure successful project delivery. Serve as thought leader for technical business processes, developing systems prototypes that promote increased efficiency and productivity on multiple levels. Perform, evaluate, and communicate thorough quality assurance at every stage of systems development. Assist in test planning and support the Technical teams in developing test cases that validate the implemented solutions against requirements. Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and ensure solutions meet business expectations. Key requirements Customer-first mindset Curiosity about AI, automation, and digital technologies, and how they can improve day‑to‑day work. Ability to bridge communications between business and technical teams. Fluency in written and spoken English, including the ability to summarise complex information. High-level of accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to self-organise. Capacity to balance priorities and workloads. Ability to facilitate workshops with senior stakeholders in order to challenge and refine requirements. Flexible and agile mindset with the ability to work across different team functions and projects. Experience of working in a global business environment. Experience in the Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical Industry. Education/ Qualifications Essential qualifications, education, and certifications necessary for success in the role. title: Product Owner - Professional Coding
jd_text: The Product Owner for our Encoder solution will be accountable for product management duties to support our Encoder solution to defining the why, who, and what..... why it is worthwhile to develop a product, who the product is for, and what features the product should contain. This role will own a product in its entirety; they have the final word on strategic and tactical product decisions. They are responsible for maintaining the product backlog and maximizing the value the product creates for the users, customers, and business. This includes championing a vision, meeting with stakeholders and customers, and knowing when to say no. These Goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to perform other job related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change. All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA and other regulations, as appropriate. Essential Functions: In addition to working as prescribed in our Performance Factors specific responsibilities of this role include: Define the overall vision in partnership with Product Strategy, Product Development, QA, and General Manager. Take the vision of the Product Strategy and translate the work into user stories. Work to implement those work items, which include: · Customer Delighter: Ability to not only listen to stakeholder wishes but anticipate customer needs as well · Storyteller: Ability to articulate what will transform that story into a product feature to delight the end user. · Delegator: Create safety and accountability by delegating task/ceremony facilitation when possible. · Knowledge Broker: Enable collaboration and empower the developers by finding the right people for them to talk to. · Conflict Resolver: Possessing the courage and the capability to engage when things get difficult and mediate to reach a solution. · Effective Escalator: Calmly and effectively provide feedback to Product Strategy and General Managers if goals are not aligned or could be reworked either inside or outside of your unit. Manage and prioritize the backlog to ensure it is stocked with clearly expressed items that help reach the product goal Regularly update and refine the backlog together with the squad Be a liaison between product and development, where needed – they help to explain and translate the how and why Collect feedback from users, customers, and stakeholders on the product increments Manage interdependencies between squad/team Enable collaboration, removing impediments to empower the squad to find solutions to move the work forward Take ownership of the work product and how it’s delivered. This includes being brave enough to have hard conversations, creating trust in the squad, calmly explaining impediments, and pivoting at a moment’s notice Travel to client sites and or conferences to lead and facilitate discussions around the product, roadmap, and collection of user feedback for progressive improvement. Planning and delivery of presentations to clients and potential customers leading to growth and adoption of the product. Minimum Requirements: Education/Experience/Certification Requirements At least 10 years of experience , with an understanding of Facility and Profee coding best practices Ability to understand product business cases and functionality creation/adoption by clients Experience communicating/presenting directly to clients Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent. Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time-management skills. Must be detail oriented and able to follow through on issues to resolution. Must be able to act both independently and as a team member. Professional

title: Business Analyst
jd_text: Business Unit and Position Summary: About Crane Crane Co. is a diversified manufacturer of highly engineered industrial products. Founded in 1855, Crane provides products and solutions to customers in the aerospace, electronics, hydrocarbon processing, petrochemical, chemical, power generation, automated merchandising, transportation and other markets. The Company has four business segments: Aerospace & Electronics, Engineered Materials, Merchandising Systems, and Fluid Handling. Crane has approximately 11,000 employees in North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Crane Co. is traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE:CR) www.craneco.com About CRANE ChemPharma & Energy CRANE ChemPharma & Energy (within Crane's Fluid Handling segment) designs and manufactures a variety of high performance products including: highly engineered check valves, sleeved plug valves, lined valves, process ball valves, high performance butterfly valves, bellows sealed globe valves, aseptic and industrial diaphragm valves, multi/quarter-turn valves, actuation, sight glasses, lined pipe, fittings and hoses, and air operated diaphragm and peristaltic pumps. Position Summary This is a great opportunity to join an exciting business with high growth potential for the right candidate. Effectively communicate insights through charts, tables, and other elements for data visualization to report to senior leadership. Assists business line manager in developing and implementing strategic plan, operational plan, monthly and quarterly forecasts, pricing strategies in line with market opportunities. Support development of market trends & competitive analysis, identifying areas or opportunities for growth. Support cross-functional team in improving and maintaining product configuration databases. Review business models and inventory stock health, suggesting paths for optimization. Develops data analytics to support discussions with customer, sales and marketing personnel, cross-functional departments and customers regarding sales and orders. Essential Qualifications / Experience: Experience/Training/Education: Required: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Mechanical Engineering / Chemical Engineering with experience in Data Analytics in applicable field or industry, ideally in Refining, Chemical, or Industrial applications. Preference: MBA, MS in Business Analysis, MS in Data Science, or equivalent experience preferred. Knowledge of: Basic design and manufacturing principals, Bills of Material, marketing and sales principles, methods and practices; applications and sales territories; technical product applications and documentations; customer service principles, practices and procedures. Skills: Proficient in advanced data analysis tools such as PowerBI Tableau, SQL, R, Python Microsoft office programs including advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and all other Microsoft Office tools. Must have the writing and oral skills to be able to prepare high quality reports and present complex ideas in front of customers and management in English. Ability to: Identify market and customer needs and make recommendations; research pricing, shipping and discounting terms and conditions by product line and account; exercise initiative in independently researching and resolving inquiries and problems; prepare clear and concise business correspondence; organize, assign and coordinate work to meet scheduled deadlines including preparation of samples and test reports; make mathematical computations quickly and accurately; understand and follow written and verbal instructions; communicate and work cooperatively with co-workers, departmental representatives, sales representatives, management, customers and vendors. title: AI Research Scientist, Agentic Systems (Remote)
jd_text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role: The Data Science team is expanding and is looking for a Data Scientist to help build the next generation of agentic systems for cybersecurity. CrowdStrike's cybersecurity data is one-of-a-kind: we process nearly a trillion behavioral events per day. You'll work where Machine Learning, Big Data, and Cybersecurity converge — training models, building AI agents, and rigorously measuring whether they work — on data and problems you won't find anywhere else. What You'll Do: Work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Threat Research Work closely with subject-matter experts in cybersecurity to understand analyst workflows and their security operations procedures Post-train LLMs and agents — supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLAIF, PPO/GRPO/DPO, reward modeling) — to automate analyst procedures and improve reliability on real security tasks Devise AI agents and combine them into increasingly complex workflows: planning and reasoning loops, tool and function calling, and retrieval and memory Research new approaches to agentic planning, and prototype state-of-the-art methods from the literature Establish objective criteria for benchmarking agentic systems — evals, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and trajectory-level metrics, with real statistical rigor Optimize prompts and inference to get the most out of every model Collaborate and coordinate across Engineering, Data Science, and Managed Services teams, and partner with engineers to take prototypes toward production Keep track of developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence and help identify, define, and prioritize areas for research What You'll Need: Excellent foundations in machine learning, probability, and statistics, with sound instincts for uncertainty, statistical skew/variance, and experimental design PhD-level depth of understanding in modern machine learning research —a doctorate itself is not required, but we expect equivalent mastery, including the ability to read, critique, implement, and improve upon current papers Experience training generative models, with a strong command of LLM training fundamentals (architecture, optimization, tokenization, data, and scaling behavior) Reinforcement learning / post-training as a core skill: RLHF/RLAIF, policy optimization (PPO/GRPO/DPO), reward modeling, and building RL environments for agents Experience building agentic systems: agent architectures (ReAct, planning, reflection), tool and function calling, and retrieval/memory/context management Experience with systematic prompt optimization, and with designing and building evals for LLM systems Fluency with GPUs, PyTorch, and the common LLM training and serving stack (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers/TRL/PEFT, DeepSpeed/FSDP, vLLM/TGI/SGLang) Strong, reproducible research engineering: clean Python and disciplined experiment tracking that your collaborators can build on Ability to work independently on ambiguous and complex objectives, and to communicate clearly within a large project team Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Bonus Points: Experience generating training data and environments — synthetic data, agent trajectories/rollouts, and task simulators Familiarity with inference-time scaling / test-time compute (search, self-consistency, verifier-guided decoding, long chain-of-thought) Experience with agent safety and guardrails: sandboxing, abuse/jailbreak resistance, and reliability for autonomous systems A knack for interpretability and failure analysis — diagnosing why a model or agent fails, not just that it does Notable open-source contributions and excellent technical writing Passionate about cybersecurity, with a firm understanding of the problem space — or passionate about applying your machine-learning skillset to a new domain such as cybersecurity (a security background is a plus, not a requirement) An independent self-starter who likes to take ownership and seeks out new challenges, and is thirsty for knowledge — never hesitant to step outside your comfort zone to learn new technologies, algorithms, and concepts #LI-Remote #LI-RC1 Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: Market leader in compensation and equity awards Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge Paid parental and adoption leaves Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections Vibrant office culture with world class amenities Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Our goals are to scale to 100s of PB of data ingress per day, while maintaining best-in-class ingest, search, and detection SLAs, as well as a best-in-class cost structure. Teams in NG SIEM have a great amount of autonomy, and own a part of the NG SIEM experience, from ideation and development to deployment and feedback. This includes ensuring high quality of the features they deliver, by writing automated tests, and performing manual tests. Moreover, we do not just throw over features to our operations teams, but we constantly observe and monitor new features in production. An important part of our work is making sure that our platform continues to be the most effective and reliable in terms of efficiency, while also ensuring the stability of the platform. Some of the critical elements that the team is working on improving is our hardware and fleet utilization across 400k CPU cores. The team is also working with our internal asset storages and enabling other teams in managing the NG SIEM dataplane. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role The CrowdStrike OCAIO team is looking for a senior technical lead to own how we measure AI models and agentic systems that perform cybersecurity tasks. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead a small team of researchers and you will personally help design, build and defend the benchmarks they ship. Our mission is to establish rigorous, reproducible standards for how well AI and agentic systems perform real security work: malware analysis, reverse engineering, threat intelligence reasoning, alert triage, investigation and response. We build our ground truth with security subject matter experts, not with other models, and we score agents on what they actually did, not only on what they said. As the Senior Lead, you define what "good" looks like for an AI system operating in a security workflow, you build the datasets, rubrics and judges that encode that definition, and you run the standing scorecards that engineering, product and research teams use to decide what ships. You set the technical bar and you meet it yourself. What You'll Do Hands-on benchmark work (about half of your time): - Design and build benchmark datasets for cybersecurity agent tasks, from task definition through expert-labeled ground truth, scoring rubrics and release. - Build and calibrate judges (LLM-based and programmatic) against expert labels, measure agreement and publish where they disagree. - Build reproducible evaluation harnesses that capture agent actions and traces, not only transcripts, so results are defensible and comparable across model versions. - Run and publish standing scorecards of CrowdStrike agents and frontier models on the same tasks, with protection, correctness and usefulness reported together. - Investigate failure modes personally: where agents collapse, why, and what evidence proves it. - Write the research: internal reports and external papers or talks that establish the benchmark's credibility. Leading the team and the function : - Lead, mentor and grow a team of researchers and engineers; review their designs, labels and code. - Set the strategy, roadmap and success metrics for evaluating AI and agentic systems across security use cases. - Define and enforce the evaluation methodology and the shared task and trace formats used across benchmarking and red teaming. - Secure and coordinate subject matter expert labeling time from SOC, threat research and malware analysis teams, and set the quality bar for every label. - Collaborate with engineering, product and threat research to turn evaluation findings into agreed pass/fail criteria and shipped improvements. - Communicate results, trade-offs and limitations clearly to technical and executive audiences. Report what was not tested as plainly as what was. What You'll Need - Hands-on cybersecurity expertise in at least one of: malware analysis and reverse engineering, incident response and threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC operations. You can label ground truth yourself and judge whether an expert's label is right. - Demonstrated experience building evaluations, benchmarks or datasets for AI or LLM systems, with shareable artifacts (papers, repositories, internal benchmarks with measured adoption). - Strong Python and data tooling skills. You write production-quality evaluation code, harnesses and analysis, and you review others' code. - Practical experience with LLMs and agentic systems: tool use, multi-step planning, sandboxing, and how to instrument and trace agent behavior. - At least 2 years leading technical people (as a team lead, tech lead or manager), with a record of growing researchers and engineers while remaining hands-on. - Ability to define, design and standardize evaluation methodologies and reproducible testing pipelines, and to defend them under scrutiny. - Broad knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape: attack techniques, defensive controls, and the analyst workflows that AI is meant to augment. - Exceptional written and spoken communication. You can present measured findings and their limitations to executives and to researchers. - Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Bonus Points - Published research or talks on AI evaluation, LLM judging, or AI security. - Experience with adversarial testing or red teaming of AI systems, and with scoring agents from observed side effects rather than text. - Experience building LLM judges and measuring judge agreement with human experts. - Experience with SOC platforms, SIEM/SOAR tooling and detection engineering. - Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK and how it maps to detection and response workflows. - Relevant security certifications (GREM, GCFA, GCIH, GCIA, OSCP or equivalent). - Experience fine-tuning or distilling models on expert-labeled decision data. #LI-JP1 #LI-GT1 #LI-Remote Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: Market leader in compensation and equity awards Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge Paid parental and adoption leaves Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections Vibrant office culture with world class amenities Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Product Manager
jd_text: What we're doing Owning a home is a foundational part of building financial security and wealth in America. However, the tools and technology that support homeownership are antiquated, dependent on things like fax machines, handwritten documentation, and hours of manual review. We're here to change it. Vesta was founded to rebuild the mortgage LOS from the ground up. Our founding belief is that the future of mortgage lending will be a fully automated process. Today, our AI augmented platform makes that a reality. Our mission has been to build a platform where AI isn’t just an add-on, but the core engine that transforms how a loan is actually manufactured. Who we are Our founding team is no stranger to the complexities of the financial industry. As early employees at Blend, they spent years together focused on creating modern cloud infrastructure for banks to power their consumer experiences. Now, with Vesta, they are transforming the mortgage industry by creating the most flexible, open, and automated origination experience, benefitting financial institutions and their customers. And, we're not alone. We've received $85M in early stage financing from top tier investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Conversion Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and Index Ventures. We value craftsmanship, boldness, self-awareness, lightheartedness, and a team-first mentality. If this sounds like you and you're excited by the idea of getting in at the ground level and building the infrastructure that will power the future of the financial industry, we would love to hear from you! Who you are - You're looking to join a team at an inflection point: the product has product-market fit, and the next few years decide how big it gets. You're willing to work hard to make it big. - You're proactive and resourceful. You move without being told, figure out what needs doing, and find a way through ambiguity and blockers rather than waiting for someone to clear the path. This is the trait that most predicts success on our team. - You want to be one of the people who actually delivers real value from AI in an industry that matters. - You love complex problems, nuanced spaces, and learning from experts (users, customer executives, industry partners). - You take pride in the dirty work, the nitty gritty, because you know that's what separates truly great products from merely good ones. - Teammates and customers describe you as "curious" and "humble". In a space as complex and old as mortgage, our customers are the experts. You respect that, and you combine their domain expertise with a firm grasp of technology and user experience to ship robust, elegant solutions. - You distill complex learnings into crisp, precise insights, especially in writing. Curiosity doesn't build a world-class product if you can't communicate what you learned. - You're a company builder and team player, excited to shape the product, the team, and the culture as they grow. - Bonus points if you have worked in financial services and/or on enterprise products. About the role Vesta has found product-market fit. Lenders run their business on our system of record, and we're at the point where AI lets us automate work that used to take rooms of people. You'd: - Own a product area end to end: understand the customer problems, write precise specs, and drive execution with engineering and design - Become an industry expert, providing the mortgage and business context the team needs to solve the most important customer problems - Work closely with Vesta's existing and prospective customers to deeply understand their needs and problems - Shape how AI gets applied to a real, regulated industry - Help shape the product team and its culture, and Vesta's as well Note: We don't expect you to have a deep understanding of the nuances of the mortgage process or industry initially. However, success in this role will require a high degree of curiosity, persistence, and willingness to learn the mortgage ecosystem. Perks & Benefits: - Robust medical, vision, & dental coverage (~100% of employee premiums covered) - FSA plan offering - 401(K) plan offering - Meaningful parental leave - 16 weeks fully paid for all new parents, birthing & non-birthing parents (applies to adoptions as well!) - Remote-first culture with a physical hub in the Bay area & New York! - Generous Work From Anywhere & Wellness Benefits - Monthly cell & wifi stipend - Monthly Doordash benefits - Open & encouraged flexible time off - Company offsites to get to know the team! Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $175,000 - $225,000/yr. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above. title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jd_text: Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Manager to define and shape a personalized, motivating, and digital-first Virta experience that helps members start strong, achieve meaningful health outcomes and sustain long-term success. As one of Virta’s most senior individual-contributor product leaders, you will set strategy across the end-to-end member journey and guide investments spanning multiple teams and functions. You will combine deep member empathy with data, experimentation and emerging AI capabilities to identify opportunities, resolve complex tradeoffs, and influence company-level priorities. Working across technology, clinical care, coaching, operations, and other cross-functional partners, you will create experiences that feel simple and cohesive to members despite the complexity behind them. This is an opportunity to define the future of consumer healthcare experiences while making a measurable difference in members’ lives. RESPONSIBILITIES - Define and drive a multi-year product strategy and investment roadmap for Virta’s end-to-end member experience, aligning multiple teams and senior leaders around company-level goals for activation, engagement, retention and health outcomes. - Identify and shape Virta’s highest-leverage consumer product opportunities, using member insights, business priorities, clinical outcomes and market developments to influence portfolio-level investment decisions. - Establish a strategic approach to personalization and adaptive experiences, leveraging data, AI and behavioral insights to better support each member’s individual needs, context, and goals. - Develop a deep understanding of members’ emotional and functional needs, translating complex clinical and care-delivery experiences into intuitive, motivating and trusted consumer products. - Establish durable experimentation, measurement, and decision-making frameworks across the member lifecycle, enabling teams to learn quickly and make evidence-based product investments. - Translate an ambitious vision into a coherent system of member experiences, platform capabilities, operating models and sequenced investments that can scale across Virta. - Serve as a trusted thought partner to Product, Design, Engineering, AI/Machine Learning, Analytics and executive leaders, bringing clarity to ambiguous problems and driving decisions across organizational boundaries. - Lead through influence across Clinical, Coaching, Operations, Regulatory and other partners to evolve Virta’s care model while balancing member value, clinical impact, business outcomes, feasibility and compliance. - Raise the quality of product thinking and execution across the organization by mentoring product leaders, strengthening product practices and modeling exceptional strategic judgment. 90 DAY PLAN Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following: - Develop a strong understanding of Virta’s members, care model, consumer product experience, business priorities and key measures of success. - Build trusted working relationships across Product, Design, Engineering, Machine Learning, Analytics, Clinical, Coaching, Operations and other key partners. - Assess the current member journey, available research, performance data and active initiatives to identify the most important opportunities and points of friction. - Develop and align stakeholders around an initial point of view on the consumer product strategy, including priority outcomes, audiences and product opportunities. - Establish a roadmap and experimentation approach for the highest-priority opportunities, with clear hypotheses, measures of success and near-term actions. MUST-HAVES - 15+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record of building consumer products that delivered meaningful, measurable improvements in activation, engagement, retention and customer outcomes. - Strong product judgment and user empathy, with an understanding of behavior change, habit formation, lifecycle engagement, segmentation and experimentation. - Demonstrated ability to translate an ambitious vision into a coherent product strategy, roadmap and sequence of investments while leading across complex cross-functional systems. - Fluency in how data, AI and personalization can create adaptive consumer experiences, along with the ability to engage deeply with Engineering, Machine Learning, Analytics, Design and other cross functional partners. VALUES-DRIVEN CULTURE Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if: - You put people first and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally - You have a strong sense of ownership and take initiative while empowering others to do the same - You prioritize positive impact over busy work - You have no ego and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience - You appreciate transparency and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information - You are evidence-based and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma - You take risks and rapidly iterate Is this role not quite what you're looking for? Join our Talent Community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/virtahealth/form/talent-community-form and follow us on Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/company/virta-health to stay connected! Virta has a location based compensation structure. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. For this role, the compensation range is $210,000-$301,000 Information about Virta’s benefits is on our Careers page at: https://www.virtahealth.com/careers. As part of your duties at Virta, you may come in contact with sensitive patient information that is governed by HIPAA. Throughout your career at Virta, you will be expected to follow Virta's security and privacy procedures to ensure our patients' information remains strictly confidential. Security and privacy training will be provided. As a remote-first company, our team is spread across various locations with office hubs in Denver and San Francisco. Clinical roles: We currently do not hire in the following states: AK, HI, RI Corporate roles: We currently do not hire in the following states: AK, DE, HI, ME, MS, OK, SD, VT. Virta uses Ashby as its applicant tracking system, which incorporates AI-powered tools (provided by OpenAI, AWS, and Google Gemini) in certain aspects of the recruiting process, including application review, candidate screening, and interview note taking; your data is not used to train AI models, and all final hiring decisions are made by Virta Health personnel. For more information, see Virta’s AI Interview Resources page. https://www.virtahealth.com/careers/ai-interview-resources

title: Site Selection Project Manager
jd_text: WHO WE ARE Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company. Vultr Cares - 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans. - 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting - Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year - 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan - Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year - $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year - Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month - Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month - Company paid Wellable subscription Join Vultr We're looking for a Project Manager, Site Selection to own end-to-end coordination of our site acquisition pipeline — from initial market intake through lease execution and handoff to delivery — across multiple concurrent real estate transactions with varying site types. This role sits at the center of a cross-functional process spanning Construction, Engineering/Design, Network Engineering, Finance, Security, Tax, and Legal, and requires someone who can keep a high-volume pipeline moving with precision, flag risk early, and drive deals to close. Key Responsibilities - Own the site selection project portfolio end to end across multiple active sites simultaneously — from initial intake and market screening through term sheet negotiation, due diligence, internal cross-functional review, deal approval, contract negotiation, and lease execution. - Coordinate cross-functional site reviews across disciplines (Construction, Engineering/Design, Network, Finance, Security, Tax): assigning owners, defining completion criteria, and holding the line on deadlines. - Drive due diligence workflows, including document/data reviews, site visits, and go/no-go decision packages, partnering closely with site selection, construction, and operator teams. - Manage lease negotiation logistics: letter of intent drafting and signature, scope of work development, internal deal approvals, and coordination with external counsel through contract review and execution. - Maintain a single source of truth for site status, health, target lease signature dates, and portfolio-level reporting to leadership. - Identify and escalate risk — schedule slippage, unowned workstreams, data discrepancies (e.g., conflicting site addresses or tracker inconsistencies) — before they threaten a deal timeline. - Coordinate with operators, brokers, and internal stakeholders (Sales, Tax, Legal, Network Engineering, Construction) to keep every function aligned on the same site data and timeline. - Support tax and incentive analysis by compiling accurate site location data (address, legal description, coordinates, estimated investment value) for internal tax teams and local government partners. Qualifications - 5+ years of experience in data center site selection, real estate acquisition, infrastructure development, or related commercial real estate, ideally supporting hyperscale, cloud, or AI infrastructure customers. - Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent, high-value real estate transactions from intake through close, with strong attention to accuracy and follow-through. - Working knowledge of power/utility infrastructure, fiber/carrier availability, zoning and permitting, and regional tax incentive structures. title: Warehouse Inbound Operations Manager
jd_text: About The Role The Warehouse Inbound Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations of Direct and Indirect Material Receipts. Responsibilities include staffing, training, safety, scheduling, receiving, shipment inspections for visible damage, coordinating with IQC, equipment maintenance, continuous improvement, and loss prevention. The Warehouse Inbound Manager is accountable for meeting the operational goals of the company with established Key Performance Indicators. ZT is in a growth mode and this position will require a leader who can help us define the processes, procedures, and systems necessary to support and sustain our long-term growth. Preferred Skills: · Experience with homebuilders, residential real estate technology, construction technology, building products, ERP systems, CRM platforms, or related software. · Experience troubleshooting data integrations and complex system-to-system processes. · Experience analyzing product, option, pricing, configuration, or other hierarchical data. · Experience with change management and helping clients adopt new technologies and processes. · Experience working with sales or presales teams. Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more. As Technical Manager, Software Platform Engineering, you will lead an engineering team within the Software Platform organization, which builds and operates the foundational services that power the firm's research and trading systems. The Software Platform organization owns the firm's HPC compute cluster, cloud environments, developer experience tooling, data platform, and operational data systems. The organization is growing, and we are looking for someone excited to be part of a platform team with a broad mandate. Your initial focus will be on developer experience — the build systems, CI/CD infrastructure, developer tooling, and deployment automation that enable engineers to build, test, deploy, and maintain software across the company — with the opportunity to expand into cloud platform services as the team evolves, including intelligent workload placement and routing, cloud resource optimization, cost governance, and operational reliability for research workloads. Your team will deliver highly reliable, performant platforms with high availability, strong observability, and consistent performance. You will improve engineering velocity and researcher productivity by reducing friction, standardizing workflows, and modernizing tooling. You will own the roadmap for your domain, grow and scale the team, and collaborate with peers across engineering, infrastructure, research, and security to balance competing priorities and make thoughtful tradeoffs.
