title: Analyst I, Falcon Complete (Remote, PST/MST)
jd_text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role: CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven, technical analysts dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our CrowdStrike virtual security operations center offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of experiences, detecting and responding to incidents as they occur in real-time for our customers. This role is open to candidates located in either PST or MST timezones. Am I an Associate Analyst, Endpoint Protection Team Candidate? Do you have a passion for cybersecurity and a strong desire to build a career protecting organizations from the world's most sophisticated threats? Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills? Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer? Do you have a foundational background in Information Technology or Information Security that you're ready to put to work? Do you excel at communicating clearly and professionally with customers and colleagues? Do you love working around like-minded, smart people who you can learn from on a daily basis? Are you excited about the evolving role of AI in security operations, including AI models, prompt engineering, and agentic SOC workflows? What You'll Do: Deliver clear, concise, and professional customer communications as the primary first point of contact. Produce high-quality written and verbal communications, recommendations, and findings to customers and internally. Triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts across endpoint, identity, email, and cloud environments. Conduct tactical analysis of EDR telemetry, log sources, and forensic artifacts to identify the scope of compromise and support remediation efforts. Investigate suspicious Microsoft 365 activity, including business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attacks, contain the threat, and deliver actionable guidance to customers. Develop and improve processes for incident detection and the execution of countermeasures. What You'll Need: Successful candidates will have training or knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Incident Handling: training or foundational knowledge in incident response processes, including the investigation of security events such as targeted threats, malware infections, and unauthorized access. Threat Landscape Awareness: foundational knowledge of attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), including familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK. Operating System Fundamentals: understanding of Windows, Mac, and Linux operating systems, including typical Windows functionality such as the file system, registry, scheduled tasks, and running processes. Systems Administration: experience administering a network and troubleshooting issues such as general connectivity and authentication issues. Has an understanding of general IT architecture configurations in small to large networks. Network Analysis Fundamentals: knowledge of network protocols, network analysis tools, and ability to perform analysis of associated network logs. Identity Platform Awareness: familiarity with identity and access management platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and similar technologies commonly found in enterprise environments. Email Security Awareness: familiarity with Microsoft 365 security, including common attack patterns such as business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) phishing. jd_text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. Partner closely with engineering, infrastructure, networking, storage, and operations teams to deliver customer-ready solutions - Drive alignment across customer needs, product roadmap, architecture decisions, and delivery execution - title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience
jd_text: Job Title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience Location: Remote, USA ABOUT THE COMPANY Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting http://www.wheel.com/www.wheel.com http://www.wheel.com. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners. You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering. WHAT YOU'LL DO (JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES) Strategy & Vision - Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product - Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making - Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through - Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution - Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur - Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations - Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data - Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration Cross-Functional Leadership - Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders - Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike - Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers WHO YOU ARE (JOB QUALIFICATIONS) - 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process - Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different - Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations - Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production - Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well - Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy - A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast Skills & Competencies - Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work - Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model - Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions - Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design - Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction - Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric - High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment SALARY AND PERKS Pay Range: $201,700-$301,700 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the final level determined (Staff or Principal), scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: - Medical, Dental and Vision - Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability - 401K match - Flexible PTO - Parental Leave - Stock options - Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. title: Principal Product Manager (AI)
jd_text: About Wisdom Wisdom blends industry expertise with advanced technology to make dental practices work better for everyone involved. We believe dentistry is about people, and we exist to make the future of dentistry stronger and more sustainable for dentists, their teams, and the patients they serve. We match administrative teams with expert billers and custom-built technology to take on the heavy lifting of dental billing while maximizing dentists’ time in-office, and their bottom line. Coming from a fresh $21M Series A round of funding we are looking for exceptional candidates to help us build a category-defining company. Wisdom has employees across the US. The Role: Principal Product Manager (AI) Dental insurance billing is one of the largest manual workflows in US healthcare. Claims aging, appeals, posting, follow-ups makes for work that today eats entire FTE teams at every dental practice. The expertise that makes it run lives in the heads of veteran dental billers. We're building AI agents that work alongside them and support them through these workflows. We're hiring a Principal PM to own a major surface of this. Small pods, all builders, reporting to the Head of Product. You'll help shape Wisdom's product strategy for the next 1-3 years. What You'll Do - Own strategy and roadmap for an AI-first product. Balance short-term wins (human-assisted tools) with long-term bets (autonomous AI agents). - Shadow revenue specialists, billers, and dental office managers to understand workflows end-to-end. Translate tribal knowledge from 10+ year industry veterans into structured product workflows and context for AI. - Be on the forefront of AI design patterns. Help us build new agentic workflows, human-in-the-loop UX patterns, AI-to-human escalation paths, and audit trails. - Define gradual autonomy models: when should AI act autonomously vs. escalate to humans. What We're Looking For - 8+ years as a Product Manager, with at least 3 years working on AI/ML products. - You're already shipping AI products. You've built things with LLMs and agent frameworks, you've felt the pain of eval infra and prompt regressions, and you have strong opinions on the mechanics of how we build. - You leverage AI across the entire stack of the job: drafting and pressure-testing strategy, running synthetic user research, building evals before specs, prototyping flows in code, and shipping PRs when it's faster than writing them up. You treat AI like a co-worker you're constantly delegating to and learning from. - You've built pure agentic or human-in-the-loop systems before. You can make tradeoffs between "AI decides, AI performs," "AI suggests, human approves," "AI acts, human audits," or even "AI skipped, human only." Bonus if you've done this in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated space where being wrong has massive consequences. Wisdom is an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

title: Completion Diagnostics Data Analyst
jd_text: The Completion Diagnostics Data Analyst is responsible for processing all of ProTechnics’ completions diagnostics data into final client deliverables accurately and within the expected turnaround times. Services include chemical tracer data, spectral gamma ray logging of proppant tracers, pressure/temperature logs, and density+spectral gamma logging of sand control completions. Responsibilities will also include explaining and interpreting all of the above products to internal and external clients as needed. DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Offshore Spectral Gamma/Density Logging: Quickly and accurately process all offshore logging data into final client deliverables (log images, LAS files, PowerPoint slide decks, etc.) within the required 2-4 hour turnaround time. Have sufficient understanding of the log to be able to answer any processing questions from internal or external clients and aid in the interpretation of the log. Onshore Spectral Gamma Logging: Process spectral gamma ray and pressure/temperature log data into all standard client deliverables. Have sufficient understanding of the logs to be able to explain the processing as well as interpret the final results to internal and external clients. Be able to modify standard deliverables as well as create new ones from scratch as required to meet client needs. Chemical Data: QC and load field injection records into internal databases. Process chemical tracer data from the analytical lab into standard reports as well as all extra deliverables (3D wellbore views, inter-well communication matrices, plot representations, etc) at a high level of accuracy and speed. Independently identify and troubleshoot any problems with the data itself or the processing of same. Other Duties: Role may also include processing and analysis of production log data (spinner, temperature, fluid density, etc.). As needed, assist in or take full ownership of one-off and longer-term projects that fall outside the scope of routine daily work. QUALIFICATIONS 2- or 4- year degree, in engineering, geology, or another petroleum-related field preferred. High School or GED required. 2+ years’ experience in well-log field-acquisition or processing strongly preferred (open- or cased-hole). Basic knowledge of well completion techniques and operations is a plus. Experience in production log processing or acquisition is a plus. Intermediate proficiency in Excel, including using and troubleshooting VBA macros helpful. Offshore jobs must be processed as soon as data is received from the field so availability for night/weekend/holiday processing is required. Chemical tracer data and onshore logs occasionally require night/weekend/holiday processing so availability to participate in a rotating on-call schedule for these products is required. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. High degree of accuracy Ability to multitask and manage responsibilities efficiently under time constraints. Good organizational skills. title: Digital Content & Experience Specialist

title: Team Lead Operations Account Management
jd_text: The Team Lead, Operations Account Management is responsible for day‑to‑day operational performance and execution for assigned clients, serving as the primary operations liaison between client facilities and internal delivery teams. This role focuses on tactical revenue cycle outcomes, ensuring accurate reporting, effective communication, and consistent execution across billing, follow‑up, collections, denials, and claim resolution workflows. This position is accountable for operational monitoring and client relationship management. The Team Lead translates client needs into clear operational priorities, monitors key performance indicators, identifies risks and trends, and supports timely issue resolution to protect cash, A/R performance, and client satisfaction. The role also provides operational mentorship to staff by reinforcing daily best practices, supporting training and performance efforts, and helping remove execution barriers. Success is measured by client retention, escalation volume, and core revenue cycle performance indicators. These Goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change. All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA and other regulations, as appropriate. Essential Functions: In addition to meeting performance expectations, this role includes the following specific responsibilities: Discrete Responsibilities (Primary Accountability) Operational Performance Monitoring: Monitor daily operational performance, battle cards, action plans, and key KPIs for assigned clients, including A/R days, cash performance, denial trends, and accuracy measures. Primary Operations Liaison: Act as the primary operational point of contact between clients and internal delivery teams, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent communication. Operational Translation: Translate client needs, issues, and requests into actionable operational priorities and execution plans. Risk & Trend Identification: Identify operational risks, analyze performance trends, and support issue resolution to prevent revenue leakage and service disruption. Reporting & Communication: Ensure accurate reporting, clear status updates, and effective issue communication to internal stakeholders and, as appropriate, client contacts. Client Scope: Lead operational work for domestic‑only clients as needed. Reporting, Trend Monitoring & Continuous Improvement Trend Monitoring & Corrective Action: Review statistical reports and dashboards to identify operational trends, risks, and deficiencies; develop and implement corrective action plans to improve timeliness, quality, and outcomes. Operational Efficiency: Lead tactical efforts to maximize operational efficiency and optimize reimbursement through standardized workflows, issue triage, and collaboration with cross-functional partners. Client & Stakeholder Relationship Management (Tactical) Liaison & Communication: Act as the primary operational point of contact between facility management and internal teams, ensuring smooth, timely communication and resolution of day-to-day issues. Service Responsiveness & Escalation: Ensure client inquiries are addressed promptly (including providing timelines to resolution), and proactively escalate risks such as unbilled accounts, claim issues, and operational blockers to leadership. Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner with internal teams (e.g., operations, finance, payer relations, technology, and strategic client management/sales counterparts) to drive resolution and maintain a consistent client experience. Contract Awareness & Compliance: Understand contract terms and ensure operational billing, invoicing, and service delivery remain within negotiated requirements. Compliance & Professional Standards Regulatory Knowledge: Maintain current knowledge of hospital billing systems, government payer programs, third-party reimbursement policies, and applicable federal/state regulations. Confidentiality: Maintain confidentiality of patient and client information without exception. Continuous Learning & Industry Awareness: Attend required meetings and remain current on industry trends, legislative changes, and best practices. Customer Invoicing & Accuracy: Ensure accuracy of customer invoices and support monthly invoicing processes as required; validate supporting detail and address discrepancies. Management Expectations / Additional Duties: Perform all functions in alignment with management expectations and complete other duties as assigned. Key Measures of Success Client Retention and Stability Reduction in Client Escalations Cash Performance vs. Goal A/R Days and Denial Trends Staff Management Responsible for ensuring area of responsibility has the talent and resources to meet short- and long-term organizational goals as well as ensuring maximum productivity and performance. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Proactively recruit, screen, and select candidates for current and future resource requirements. Effectively orient new hires to ensure a positive and productive employee engagement experience. Ensure structure and hiring plans (within budget) are appropriate for performance and productivity levels required. Utilize the company’s performance management program as designed to align individual performance to overall performance objectives. Meet all completion requirements at a high quality level. Provide ongoing performance feedback. Identify and take appropriate action for non-performance. Ensure each employee has a yearly performance review that is reviewed with employee and the review to be sent to Human Resources each year. Ensure each employee has a clear and thorough understanding of their role and responsibilities. Keep job descriptions current for each position. Actively support and participate in organizational development and training programs. Meet all completion requirements at a high quality level. Mentor, guide, and coach direct reports in order to expand their capabilities and performance. Communicate all corporate matters in a positive and timely manner as directed by Corporate Communications or senior managements. Administer all internal policies and procedures in accordance with corporate, human resources, budgetary, and finance guidelines. Ensure accuracy of staff data records. Comply with all employment laws and regulations including, but not limited to, equal employment opportunities for all. Minimum Requirements: Education/Experience/Certification Requirements Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience (to support internal flexibility for hiring and promotion). 5+ years of experience in hospital revenue cycle functions with strong exposure to billing and follow-up/collections and claim resolution. Working knowledge of insurance regulations, reimbursement practices, procedure and diagnosis coding, and automated billing workflows. Demonstrated ability to work issues to resolution, including complex account research, root cause identification, and corrective actions. Strong client-facing communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to explain operational findings, timelines, and next steps clearly. Excellent critical thinking, organizational, and time-management skills with strong attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word) and comfort working across multiple systems and reporting outputs. Preferred Qualifications: 2+ years Medicare hospital billing experience and/or demonstrated expertise with government payers (Medicare/Medicaid). Experience supporting hospital billing platforms and/or EHR/RCM systems (e.g., Thrive, Epic, Cerner, or comparable tools). Advanced revenue cycle analytics capability (e.g., trending denials/underpayments, operational KPI reporting, dashboard interpretation). Prior experience in a role requiring client management, escalations, service recovery, and cross-functional coordination. Exposure to invoicing processes, contract compliance validation, and operational performance governance. Manager

title: IT Infrastructure Manager
jd_text: CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture. A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down. CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program. Position Overview: The IT Infrastructure Manager leads a team responsible for the engineering, delivery, modernization, and continuous improvement of CCM’s enterprise infrastructure platforms. This role is accountable for designing, building, and delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable technology solutions across CCM’s hybrid infrastructure environment. This is a BUILD-focused leadership role responsible for infrastructure strategy, engineering standards, project delivery, automation, platform modernization, and operational readiness. The IT Infrastructure Manager partners closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk, Technology Operations, PMO, and business technology stakeholders to ensure infrastructure solutions are well-designed, well-documented, secure, repeatable, and ready for operational support. This role encompasses cloud infrastructure, on-premises infrastructure, network engineering, identity and access platforms, Microsoft 365 and collaboration foundations, endpoint platform foundations, automation, Infrastructure as Code, and enterprise platform delivery. Job Responsibilities: Develop and execute short- and long-term infrastructure roadmaps that support CCM’s business growth, technology modernization, and operational resilience. Translate enterprise technology objectives into practical infrastructure plans across hybrid cloud, AWS, Azure, networking, identity, endpoint foundations, collaboration platforms, and core enterprise services. Define and maintain infrastructure engineering standards, reference architectures, design patterns, documentation expectations, and operational readiness requirements. Drive scalable, repeatable infrastructure delivery through automation, Infrastructure as Code, standard templates, reusable patterns, and disciplined change management. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security & Risk to ensure infrastructure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, security controls, compliance expectations, and business continuity requirements. Evaluate emerging technologies, vendors, services, tools, and delivery models that improve reliability, scalability, cost efficiency, security, and engineering velocity. Develop business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and recommendations for infrastructure investments, modernization initiatives, and platform improvements. Lead the design, engineering, and implementation of infrastructure solutions across CCM’s hybrid environment, including AWS, Azure, on-premises platforms, networking, identity/IAM, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, and endpoint platform foundations. Oversee infrastructure project delivery from intake through design, implementation, testing, documentation, transition, and operational handoff. Ensure new infrastructure solutions are secure by design, observable, resilient, cost-conscious, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards. Drive adoption of modern deployment practices, including Infrastructure as Code, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated configuration, scripting, and repeatable release patterns. Provide leadership for infrastructure modernization efforts, lifecycle management, cloud adoption, platform consolidation, technical debt reduction, and service improvement initiatives. Ensure infrastructure designs include appropriate monitoring, alerting, logging, backup, recovery, capacity, performance, and support requirements before transition to Operations. Partner with Technology Operations to ensure clean handoffs, clear runbooks, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and operational support models. Manage engineering delivery across core infrastructure domains, including cloud platforms, network services, identity services, directory services, collaboration platforms, and enterprise productivity foundations. Support AWS as a required platform capability and Azure as a preferred platform capability, ensuring cloud environments are built with strong governance, security, resiliency, automation, and cost-management practices. Provide leadership across network engineering capabilities such as LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, firewall coordination, connectivity, segmentation, cloud networking, and performance optimization. Guide identity and access platform initiatives involving Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, privileged access, conditional access, lifecycle management, and least-privilege access models. Support Microsoft 365 and collaboration platform foundations, including governance, platform configuration, security alignment, service enablement, and enterprise adoption needs. Partner with endpoint, security, and operations teams to ensure endpoint platform foundations are standardized, manageable, secure, and aligned with enterprise requirements. Partner with Security & Risk to embed security requirements into infrastructure designs, implementation plans, and operational readiness criteria. Ensure infrastructure platforms support appropriate controls for identity, access, logging, encryption, vulnerability management, patching, lifecycle management, backup, recovery, and resiliency. Support disaster recovery, business continuity, incident readiness, and infrastructure resilience planning. Participate in major incident reviews, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and continuous improvement activities as an infrastructure engineering leader. Ensure infrastructure documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, implementation records, and support procedures remain current and audit-ready. Establish strong delivery practices that balance speed, quality, security, supportability, and long-term maintainability. Maintain clear communication with IT leadership, project stakeholders, Technology Operations, Security & Risk, Enterprise Architecture, PMO, business partners, and vendors. Provide executive-ready updates on infrastructure initiatives, risks, delivery progress, resource needs, dependencies, and decision points. Define and track key performance indicators related to infrastructure delivery, platform health, project execution, technical debt reduction, automation, and operational readiness. Serve as an escalation point for complex infrastructure engineering issues, major production concerns, and high-priority platform decisions. Ensure infrastructure work is prioritized, planned, delivered, documented, and transitioned effectively. Lead, coach, and develop a team of infrastructure engineers and technical professionals. Set clear goals, priorities, standards, and expectations for team delivery, quality, documentation, collaboration, and accountability. Manage team capacity, resource planning, work assignments, performance feedback, hiring, onboarding, and professional development. Build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, engineering discipline, service excellence, and cross-functional partnership. Promote knowledge sharing, standardization, mentoring, and repeatable delivery practices across the infrastructure team. Manage vendor relationships, technology evaluations, renewals, support agreements, and infrastructure-related procurement activities. Support infrastructure budget planning, forecasting, cloud cost management, licensing reviews, and cost optimization efforts. Partner with PMO and IT leadership to manage the infrastructure project portfolio, prioritize demand, identify delivery risks, and ensure alignment to enterprise objectives. Evaluate infrastructure investments based on business value, risk reduction, operational impact, scalability, security, and total cost of ownership. Participate in escalation support for major incidents, high-priority infrastructure issues, and critical production events. Occasional work outside standard business hours may be required to support planned maintenance, production changes, incident response, and project implementations. Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. One or more industry-recognized certifications in cloud technologies, infrastructure automation, project management, cybersecurity, networking, endpoint management, or IT service management, preferred. 8+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, network engineering, systems engineering, or related technology roles. 3+ years of experience leading infrastructure, platform, systems, network, or cloud engineering teams. Advanced experience delivering infrastructure solutions in a hybrid enterprise environment. Experience leading infrastructure projects from design through implementation, documentation, transition, and support readiness. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies. Experience with CI/CD, Git-based workflows, release management, configuration management, and repeatable deployment practices. Experience with Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, endpoint platform foundations, and enterprise productivity services. Experience with ITSM practices, change management, incident/problem management, operational readiness, and production support transition. Advanced experience in vendor management, budgeting, cost analysis, and infrastructure investment planning. Experience working in a regulated or security-conscious environment; financial services or mortgage industry experience, preferred. Advanced technical knowledge of AWS, Azure, hybrid infrastructure, virtualization, Windows and Linux server platforms, enterprise storage, backup/recovery, networking, and identity platforms. Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and identity lifecycle management. Knowledge of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, routing, switching, load balancing, cloud networking, and network segmentation. Knowledge of AWS is required; Azure experience, preferred. Advanced understanding of infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, networking, identity and access management, Microsoft enterprise platforms, automation, and operational support models. Advanced understanding of monitoring, logging, alerting, observability, capacity planning, performance management, and service reliability practices. Comfortable operating in a large, complex, and rapidly evolving organization. Skilled in leadership, strategic planning, decision-making, and driving execution to achieve business objectives. Skilled in communication, including communicating complex technical topics effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Skilled in partnering across Infrastructure, Operations, Security & Risk, Architecture, PMO, and business teams. Highly organized, delivery-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Skilled in evaluating and balancing competing priorities, including quality, security, cost, delivery timelines, and operational requirements. Skilled in aligning technology services with customer requirements, business objectives, and organizational reliability standards. Skilled in talent development, process improvement, standards enhancement, and building effective technical teams. title: Clinical Informatics Specialist
jd_text: About Crossover Health Crossover Health is creating the future of health as it should be. A national, team-based medical group with a focus on wellbeing and prevention that extends beyond traditional sick care, the company delivers an entirely new model of healthcare—Primary Health—built on the foundation of trusted relationships, an interdisciplinary care team approach, and outcomes-based payment. Crossover’s Primary Health model integrates primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation and more, and delivers care in surround-sound—in-person, virtually and via asynchronous messaging. Together we are building a community of members that embraces healthcare as a proactive part of their lifestyle. Job Summary Job Responsibilities The Clinical Application & Informatics Specialist plays a key role in supporting and optimizing clinical systems, particularly EHR and related applications. This mid-level role combines informatics strategy with hands-on application support and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll serve as both a systems expert and a clinical operations partner—helping bridge technology with real-world care delivery. Informatics & Strategic Enablement: Lead clinical informatics initiatives that support the integration and optimization of EHR and other clinical systems. Collaborate with product, IT, and data teams to ensure clinical requirements are reflected in platform design and functionality. Gather and prioritize provider and clinical staff feedback to support system improvements and user experience enhancements. Contribute to interoperability efforts, including the evaluation of data exchange standards, APIs, and vendor integrations. Application Configuration & Support: Configure and maintain clinical applications (e.g., Athenahealth, Elation) to align with evolving workflows. Provide tier-2 support for application-related issues and escalate to vendors or IT when needed. Participate in software upgrades, testing, and system validation. Assist in managing vendor relationships and ensuring service-level expectations are met. Training & Adoption: Develop training materials, job aids, and tip sheets to support user onboarding and change management. Deliver training and go-live support to providers, nurses, and operational staff. Document clinical workflows and maintain system configuration records. Project Coordination: Support project timelines, testing plans, and implementation checklists for system changes or new tool rollouts. Track KPIs and performance metrics related to system usage and provider satisfaction. Participate in informatics and operations meetings to align on organizational goals and identify opportunities for improvement. The responsibilities of the Operations Manager - BioServices involves overseeing all projects performed in the BioServices area for multiple commercial and government clients and assembling various types of kits and label printing. title: Application Architect I

title: Global Procurement Category Lead Engineering and Construction
jd_text: This role leads multiple global Category Management teams and is responsible for overseeing the development and execution of category management strategies across the entire CSL group to ensure best possible value for CSL while managing risk and maintaining compliance in procurement practices. This will be directly involved in major local to global sourcing or bid activities, driving key transformational projects, and building and maintaining relationships with key senior stakeholders internal to CSL Group and within large, global vendors. Take a leadership position and drive collaborate with the respective business unit on complex problem resolution, investigative data analytics, process reengineering and establishment of a sustainable program that will fill a global need while being consistent within all Company areas affected. Drive Innovation Lead and participate in global transformation projects and continuous improvement initiatives as required to ensure the delivery of targeted benefits. Minimum 2 years senior leadership experience, preferably of a global team. Minimum 5 years in global team management. Strong communication and influencing skills and ability to deal with ambiguity and building bridges Strong understanding of the A&E/EPC/EPCM, CQV/CSV categories and business Understanding of the pharmaceutical industry or related industry preferred but not essential Competencies Maintains an external and strategic focus for self and team Ensures teams are set up for collaboration Creates an accountable working environment Instills personal flexibility in self and team Ensures clarity around the strategy Coaches effectively Additionally, this role requires other knowledge, skills and competencies including: Basic strategic orientation, inquisitive, comfortable with ambiguity, and self-motivated to identify trends and improvement opportunities aligned with business objectives and strategic plans. Strong executive presence demonstrated leadership and collaboration skills with ability to build effective relationships and influence peers and key stakeholders. Demonstrated strength and ability to organize and lead global teams. Strong project management skills with ability to plan tasks, assign resources, manage progress, remove barriers, manage change, resolve conflict, build consensus, and motivate team members across multiple projects concurrently. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messages to the given audience, present information in a clear and concise manner, apply creative approaches to engage audiences, manage change, resolve conflict, and build consensus. Solid Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, and Supplier Relationship Management knowledge The position also requires the ability to build and maintain strong relationships and collaborate effectively with all levels and cross functionally within the organization. title: Fixed Income Operations Analyst
jd_text: Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future. Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. You will be working with strategies that are at the forefront of machine learning and statistical trading. The strategies have been carefully designed to generate non-correlated returns. Our firm and its strategies are the product of many years of meticulous research and craftsmanship, and you will lead the way in bringing them to investors. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more. As a Fixed Income Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting Voleon’s fixed income operations. You will be responsible for overseeing workflows related to trade settlements, corporate actions, and reconciliations. In addition to managing day-to-day operational processes, you will contribute to cross-functional initiatives aimed at enhancing and scaling Voleon’s operational infrastructure. This role sits within the Fund Operations team, working closely with colleagues across trading, research, and accounting. You will report directly to the Fund Operations Manager and collaborate regularly with senior leadership, including the CFO. This position offers a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact as a core member of Voleon’s credit operations function. RESPONSIBILITIES - Oversee fixed income trade settlement operations, including trade exception management, inquiries, allocations, fail resolution, and position transfers - Manage the end-to-end corporate actions process by conducting research, evaluating event details, and coordinating with traders on elections and potential liabilities - Maintain and summarize an internal workboard leveraged by trading, research, and engineering teams, ensuring effective communication and cross-functional alignment - Reconcile internal books and records with the prime brokers and fund administrator, promptly investigating and resolving breaks - Collaborate with the Fund Accounting team to ensure all transactions are accurately recorded, including participation in cash reconciliations and month-end reviews - Enhance operational efficiency through process improvements and automation initiatives - Support firm-wide projects such as broker onboardings, restructurings, and new account setups - Participate in cross-training programs, workflow reviews, and coverage planning to promote team scalability and resilience - Liaise with external service providers to identify process improvements and maintain compliance with evolving policies and control standards - Contribute to the development and refinement of internal policies, procedures, and best practices REQUIREMENTS - 5-10 years of finance experience, ideally in an operations role or other middle office role at a hedge fund, broker-dealer, or fund administrator - Ability to work between the hours of 7am to 5pm PST - Advanced abilities in Microsoft Excel - Experience working with or the ability to learn enterprise-level accounting software and develop efficient processes - Experience automating manual processes (preferred) with a focus on leveraging AI LLMs and AI coding tools - Experience working for a hedge fund, broker-dealer, or fund administrator and simple accounting for monthly-close (preferred) - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or Accounting (preferred) - Authorization to work in the United States “FRIENDS OF VOLEON” CANDIDATE REFERRAL PROGRAM If you have a great candidate in mind for this role and would like to have the potential to earn $7,500 if your referred candidate is successfully hired and employed by The Voleon Group, please use this form https://voleon.com/referrals/ to submit your referral. title: Senior Operations Manager
jd_text: Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year. We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own Vendor Performance Management: Run the weekly performance cadence across all fulfillment vendors: scorecard reviews, follow-ups, and corrective action plans; and hold partners accountable to SLAs with persistence and professionalism. - Manage Partner Relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of fulfillment vendors: own the recurring meeting cadence, lead business reviews, advocate for Vetcove externally, and keep relationships strong through the ups and downs of operational performance. - Analyze at Scale: Interrogate large datasets (SQL, Excel, BI tools) to identify root causes, quantify operational impact, and build the case for process and integration changes. Defend your conclusions with data. - Partner with Product & Engineering: Translate recurring operational failure modes into integration and fulfillment improvements; write clear requirements, drive prioritization, and follow through until fixes ship and the metrics move. - Operationalize New Initiatives: Take run-state ownership of newly launched programs: build the SOPs, own the KPIs, and make the operational decisions that keep them healthy at scale. - Build Operational Rigor: Author and maintain SOPs, escalation paths, and process documentation that make our vendor operations consistent, auditable, and scalable as the platform grows. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5-8 years of experience in operations, program management, marketplace/ecommerce operations, or supply chain – ideally in roles where you were accountable for external partner performance. - A documented record of relentless follow-through: you chase answers across organizations, escalate when needed, never let a thread die, and deliver on time without being reminded. - Strong analytical skills: proficiency in SQL (or demonstrated equivalent), advanced Excel/Sheets, and comfort drawing defensible conclusions from large, messy datasets. - Exceptional attention to detail: you notice the mismatched count, the silent data gap, the SLA miss buried in an average. - Experience managing vendor or partner relationships end to end; serving as a partner’s main point of contact, and balancing relationship-building with direct, constructive accountability conversations. - Excellent written communication and the ability to work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams. - Self-directed and highly organized in a fully remote environment. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in ecommerce fulfillment, 3PL, pharmacy, or distribution operations. - Familiarity with BI/analytics tools (e.g., Hex, Looker, Tableau) and building or maintaining operational dashboards. - Background in animal health, healthcare, or another regulated fulfillment category. BENEFITS (FULL TIME ROLES) - 100% remote within the USA - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Automatic 401k contribution - Employee referral program - At home office set up - Bi-annual company retreats - Open vacation policy - Equity - Monthly team events The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is: $100,000/year -$150,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits.
